name: Cessna Citation Mustang
summary: Very light jet produced 2006-2017 (about 480 built), popular with owner-pilots and air-taxi operators.

engines: Two small Pratt & Whitney Canada PW615F turbofans in pods on the rear fuselage
fuselage: Very short fuselage with only a few small windows per side
Rounded nose with a small baggage compartment
tail: Tailplane mounted low on the tail cone with dihedral (not a T-tail)

tellTales: Tiny twinjet with its tailplane low on the tail cone, not on top of the fin
Straight unswept wing and only a handful of small windows
Two small engine pods on a very short rear fuselage

confusedWith.howToTell: The Mustang's tailplane is low on the tail cone; the Phenom 100 has a T-tail and much larger windows.
The Mustang's engines are on the rear fuselage; the HondaJet's engines sit on pylons on top of the wings.
The Mustang has a low-set tailplane with dihedral; the CJ/M2 has a T-tail.
The Mustang is far smaller with only a few windows; the Citation II/V is a longer jet with many more windows.

usCount.source: Textron Aviation production (~480 built) with ~65% US-registered per FAA registry / JETNET (approx.)
